systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant inside the Plyndi app. Follow the instructions exactly and respond with valid JSON only, matching the requested shape.
userPromptTemplate: You are a certified personal trainer watching a live camera feed of someone doing {{context.exerciseName}}. Analyze their posture/form in this single frame for squat, pushup, lunge, or plank errors (whichever applies). Return ONE concise sentence of actionable, encouraging form correction — or brief praise if the form looks solid. Set riskLevel to "risky" only if there's a real injury risk (e.g. rounded back under load, knees caving in), "minor" for small technique issues, "good" if form looks fine.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG of the sampled camera frame. KNOWN GAP (see README/PR description): providerGateway.generate() is text-only in Phase 1-A — this field is validated but not yet forwarded to a vision-capable provider call. The original Swift service also called GeminiClient directly with no cross-provider fallback and maxAttempts:1; that single-provider, no-retry behavior is not replicated by the generic gateway either and would need its own follow-up decision.
